requirements.title: Common event envelope schema
requirements.description: All events follow a common envelope: id (TEXT UUID), timestamp (TEXT ISO-8601), domain (TEXT), event_type (TEXT), payload (TEXT JSON). Causality fields: is_intervention (INTEGER 0/1), hypothesis_id (TEXT UUID nullable).

requirements.title: SQLite events table
requirements.description: Events stored in lifestyle.db SQLite file. JSON payloads via TEXT columns. Extensible without schema migrations when adding new domains. Single-writer constraint: all writes via API.

requirements.title: Event indexing strategy
requirements.description: Composite index on (domain, timestamp) for efficient time-range queries. Index on event_type. Partial index on hypothesis_id WHERE NOT NULL for experiment queries.
